scope: Six downloaded synthetic runtime-security reports, reduced to pass/check data, raw report SHA256 and repository source hashes. Source bindings verified against current files. No environment, credentials, private keys, SQL rows or customer evidence included. Runtime-job builds are separate from native image-scan builds; source identity is shared, image identity is not asserted equal.
